summary: Equinor ASA furnished a Form 6-K attaching its September 22, 2026 press release detailing weekly repurchases under the third tranche of its 2026 share buy-back programme, announced July 22, 2026 and running July 23 to no later than October 26, 2026. From September 14-18, 2026 the company bought 535,701 own shares at an average NOK 419.4578, totaling NOK 224.7M; accumulated tranche buy-backs reach 5,567,791 shares at NOK 393.3827. Equinor now holds 20,202,526 treasury shares, 0.85% of capital (0.38% excluding share-savings-programme shares). Watch ongoing daily execution pace and any programme expansion.
